data.group: Daemon Prince of Nurgle with Wings
data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit that is neither a **MONSTER** nor a **VEHICLE** is picked to Fall Back while this model is within 6" of it, each of its models has to make a **Desperate Escape** test, and a **Battle-shocked** enemy unit subtracts 1 from every one of those tests.
